name: three-ws
description: three.ws for Grok Build: turn a sentence or a photo into a textured 3D model (GLB) or a rigged, animation-ready avatar, auto-rig a GLB, search thousands of CC0 props, characters and motion clips, render a model so Grok can check it, and embed the result on a site. Catalog search is free with no account; making or rigging a model needs a free three.ws account (Grok Build signs you in). No tool spends money.
